title.en: What readings fix of the unread

statement.en: Where a formation's lumping tells an unread occasion from every read one, being in its lump decided, a selection through the readings that selects a law reading through the lumping also selects twins agreeing on every reading and taking every value there.
statement.zh: 一形成之归并分一未读之时于每一读处，彼归并可判定，则经读处而选者若选一经归并而读之律，亦选其孪生，于每一读处皆合而于此处取每一值。

laws.en: With being in x's lump decided, where no read occasion is lumped with x, the class going alike across the lumping is free at x beyond the readings: every member's values on the read occasions combine with every value at x.
laws.zh: 「在 x 之归并中」可判定，未有读处与 x 同归，则随归并无别之类于读处之外在 x 为自由：每一成员于读处之值，与 x 处之每一值皆可相合。

laws.en: So every act law reading through the lumping that a selection through agreement on the readings selects has, for every value, a selected twin reading through the lumping, agreeing with it on every reading and taking that value at x.
laws.zh: 故凡经读处之合而选者所选之经归并而读之行律，于每一值皆有所选之孪生，经归并而读，于每一读处与之合，于 x 取此值。

laws.en: Example, why the exact form takes a list: with one occasion, a constant lumping and two act values, the occasion read exactly where P holds, the readings fix the act exactly where ¬¬P, where the exact form would say P.
laws.zh: 例，确形何以需列：一时、归并恒定、行有二值，此时恰于 P 成立时为读，则读处定此行恰当 ¬¬P，而确形当言 P。

laws.en: Where acts read a state formed from what couples in, acts that differ at two occasions come from states that differ, and states that differ from couplings that differ.
laws.zh: 行读由所耦合入者所成之态，则二时之行异出于态异，态异出于耦合之异。

laws.en: Witness: occasions with a cue and a content, read where the cue is up, the content act answering with the content (Learning.Shift's pattern); for every selection through agreement on the readings that selects the content act, a formation coupled into the cue has a selected twin answering otherwise at an unread occasion; among laws reading only the content, agreement on the readings fixes the act there.
laws.zh: 例：时有讯与内容，讯起处为读，内容之行以内容答（Learning.Shift 之式，以其位为讯）；凡经读处之合而选且选内容之行者，耦合入讯之形成于一未读之时有所选之孪生而答异；唯读内容之诸律，于读处合则于此处行定。

laws.en: Witness, the converses fail: a read and an unread occasion differ while their content acts agree; with the state the occasion and the act its content, states differ and acts agree, and with the coupling the occasion and the state its content, couplings differ and states agree.
laws.zh: 例，其逆不成：一读一未读之时相异而其内容之行同；以时为态、内容为行，则态异而行同；以时为耦合、内容为态，则耦合异而态同。

hypotheses.en: Any types of occasions, values and lumps; the freedom and the twin need being in the target's lump decided and no read occasion lumped with it, and no list or decision of the read occasions.
hypotheses.zh: 时、值与归并之任一型；自由与孪生需「在所求之归并中」可判定且无读处与之同归，读处无需为列或可判定。

hypotheses.en: Where the lumping ties the occasion to a read one, the act is fixed by generalization through lumping (lumped_determines; exactly there, Learning.determines_lumped_iff, with the read occasions listed, equality of lumps decided and two act values): read here, cited, not proved again.
hypotheses.zh: 归并系此时于一读处，则其行为归并之泛化所定（lumped_determines；恰在彼处，Learning.determines_lumped_iff，读处为列、归并之相等可判定、行有二值）：于此读之，引而不重证。

does_not_show.en: That fixed is right: for a law reading through the lumping and fitting the world on the read occasions, its act at an occasion sharing a read one's lump is right exactly where the world agrees at the two (Learning.lumped_right_iff).
does_not_show.zh: 所定即正：经归并而读且于读处合于世界之律，其于与一读处同归之时之行，恰当世界于二处同值时为正（Learning.lumped_right_iff）。

does_not_show.en: Intention, anticipation, another's false belief or an incentive to differ where unread; when, in two stages, differing there is uniquely best in the order given prospects give is stated in when-complying-when-read-is-best.
does_not_show.zh: 意图、预期、他者之误信，或于未读处行异之诱因；于两阶段，彼处行异何时于所予之望之序中唯一最优，见 when-complying-when-read-is-best。

does_not_show.en: A reader misled: it lies outside the chain of acts, states and couplings apart, in prose only.
does_not_show.zh: 读者为所误：其在行、态、耦合之异之链外，唯以文述之。

does_not_show.en: Which lumping an actual formation has, and the probabilistic form of the chain (the data-processing inequality).
does_not_show.zh: 实际之形成有何归并，及链之概率之形（数据处理不等式）。

detail.en: Occasions with a cue: for every selection through agreement on the readings that selects the content act, a formation coupled into the cue has, at the unread occasion with content true, a selected twin agreeing with the content act on every reading and answering false (Learning.Cue.seen_twin).
detail.zh: 有讯之时：凡经读处之合而选且选内容之行者，耦合入讯之形成于内容为真之未读之时，有所选之孪生，于每一读处与内容之行合而答假（Learning.Cue.seen_twin）。

detail.en: A read and an unread occasion differing only in the cue: a state keeping the cue tells them apart while the content act gives one answer (Learning.Cue.apart_with_content_alike).
detail.zh: 唯讯相异之一读一未读之时：存讯之态分之，而内容之行同答（Learning.Cue.apart_with_content_alike）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: Unread imports only Learning. It reuses lumped_determines and Training.unselected_beyond_data, and reads Learning.determines_lumped_iff as the exact form (cited, not used in a proof); the witnesses are on pairs of truth values.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：Unread 唯引 Learning。其用 lumped_determines 与 Training.unselected_beyond_data，读 Learning.determines_lumped_iff 为确形（引而未用于证）；诸例于真值之对上。

next_delta.en: Runs of the frozen measurements of the chain's correspondence on four trained checkpoints (TR2's Stage B): cues varied apart from content and the schedule apart from the cue, with identical-input arms; it can refute a stated lumping or an implementation, never the law; review by a person. On small trained networks (TR2's Stage A) the measurement ran on 6 November 2026, on Ren's yes, reported without a verdict (experiments/formations-that-read/README.md, the runs made).
next_delta.zh: 于四已训之检查点上链之对应之冻结量测之运行（TR2 之乙段）：分讯于内容而变，分读之时于讯而变，设同入之臂；唯能驳所述之归并或其实现，不驳此律；人之审查。于小型已训网络上（TR2 之甲段），此量测已于2026年11月6日经 Ren 之可而运行，报而不判（experiments/formations-that-read/README.md，已作之运行）。

correspondence.en: Indistinguishability: two laws agreeing on every reading are selected alike by every selection through them. AI reading: read as evaluation and deployment, it says two laws reading through one lumping can agree on every reading and differ unread only where the lumping tells the occasion from every read one. Read with deceptive alignment (Hubinger and others 2019), such a law acting alike on every reading acts otherwise unread only there; differing rates, as in alignment faking (Greenblatt and others 2024), are not so bounded. Intention, anticipation and incentive are not represented; a law drawing afresh can act otherwise unread without telling read from unread (Hubinger and others' §4.5). A state telling read from unread while the act does not differ reads as detection not acted on, and a coupling taking in the cue while the state keeps only the content as detectable and not detected; measurements of the first are the chain's failed converse. Read with a supervised reporter, the identification limit of eliciting latent knowledge (Christiano, Cotra and Xu 2021). The probabilistic form of the chain is the data-processing inequality. These are readings, not containments.
correspondence.zh: 不可分辨：于每一读处相合之二律为经读处之每一选所同选。AI 解读：读作评估与部署，其言经同一归并而读之二律可于每一读处皆合而于未读处相异，唯在此归并分此时于每一读处者。与欺骗对齐并读（Hubinger 等 2019），此类律于每一读处同行者，唯于彼处于未读处行异；率之差，如对齐伪装（Greenblatt 等 2024），不受此界。意图、预期与诱因未表；每处重抽其行之律不分读与未读亦可于未读处行异（Hubinger 等 §4.5）。态分读与未读而行不异，读作察而未据以行；耦合入讯而态唯存内容，读作可察而未察；前者之测为链之逆不成。与受督之报者并读，为引出潜知之辨识之限（Christiano、Cotra 与 Xu 2021）。链之概率之形为数据处理不等式。皆为读，非包含。

detail.en: Learning.Lumped, Free, Determines and lumped_determines; Training.Through, AgreeOn and unselected_beyond_data (determines_lumped_iff and lumped_right_iff cited).
detail.zh: Learning.Lumped、Free、Determines 与 lumped_determines；Training.Through、AgreeOn 与 unselected_beyond_data（引 determines_lumped_iff 与 lumped_right_iff）。

detail.en: Off its courses a law is installed only where the representation lumps a history with a course. Here the read occasions are fixed in advance, as data are in generalization through lumping; there the data are the courses the candidate itself generates, and its twin needs laws reading what has stood to keep them: the same boundary, with no instance theorem.
detail.zh: 离其所行之迹，律唯于表示将一史与一迹同归处为所装。此处读处预定，如归并之泛化中之资料；彼处资料为候选自生之迹，其孪生需读已立者之律以存之：界同，无实例之定理。

detail.en: What choices show of an order: the same question for the order a chooser's choices come from.
detail.zh: 所择所示之序：同问于择者之择所出之序。

detail.en: Its twin and the fixing at two stages, read and unread, with prospects: when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is uniquely best, the twin where the stages are told apart and the fixing where they are tied.
detail.zh: 此孪生与其定于读与不读两阶段而有望：读时从而不读时依己律何时唯一最优；两阶段可分处有此孪生，合处有其定。

history.en: 29 October 2026: added (RF round 1), what readings fix of the unread: the twin where the formation can tell, a one-occasion example fixed exactly where ¬¬P, the chain of acts, states and couplings with its converses failing, and the cue witnesses; after a review of the plan, a review of the Lean and a cold read of the texts; study section 446.
history.zh: 2026年10月29日：新增（RF 第一轮），读处所定于未读处者：能分处之孪生，一时之例所定恰当 ¬¬P，行、态、耦合之链及其逆不成，讯之诸例；经计划之审、Lean 之审与文之冷读；研究第 446 节。

history.en: 30 October 2026, board item RF, RF7 (study section 463): related to when-complying-when-read-is-best; the next step drops disclosure or concealment in two stages, whose two-stage comparison with the continuation value is now stated there, disclosure and concealment readings of it; the second item of what it does not show points to it; the correspondence says two laws reading through one lumping can agree on every reading and differ unread only where the lumping tells the occasion from every read one, reads with deceptive alignment that such a law acting alike on every reading acts otherwise unread only there, says differing rates, as in alignment faking, are not so bounded, no longer calls telling the occasion apart a necessary condition of what deceptive alignment and alignment faking describe, and adds that a law drawing afresh can act otherwise unread without telling read from unread (Hubinger and others' §4.5); no statement or declaration changed.
history.zh: 2026年10月30日，工作板条目 RF，RF7（研究第 463 节）：与 when-complying-when-read-is-best 相关联；下一步删去两阶段中之示或隐（其带接续之值之两阶段比较已于彼陈述，示与隐为其读）；所不示之第二项指向之；对应言经同一归并而读之二律可于每一读处皆合而于未读处相异，唯在此归并分此时于每一读处者；与欺骗对齐并读，此类律于每一读处同行者唯于彼处于未读处行异；言率之差，如对齐伪装，不受此界；不复称分此时为欺骗对齐与对齐伪装所述者之必要条件，并补言每处重抽其行之律不分读与未读亦可于未读处行异（Hubinger 等 §4.5）；无一陈述或声明改变。
